messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired for service 'inference-api-prod-alt' -> rotation 'ops-night' (INC-20260315-01). Auto-page at 02:34Z. Severity: P1. Pager: pagerduty.

pagerduty: Triggered by alert: 5xx-rate > 10% over 1m for /v1/generate on inference-api-prod (metric-stream: prod-edge). Bindings: service=inference-api-prod-alt, tag=canary.

alice: acked. I'm oncall. seeing pages from multiple regions — is this target expected?

bob: we should not be paged to ops-night for that service. The PD binding for 'inference-api-prod-alt' was supposed to point to ops-day rotation. Looks like a schedule/tag mismatch.

carla: checking infra — I see a terraform change merged last night (PR #987) that renamed service tag 'inference-prod-v2' -> 'inference-prod-canary'. PD routing rules use tag -> rotation mapping, so if the tag changed, the page goes to the wrong rotation.

alice: ugh. so customers hit prod inference but night ops got paged. Sam, can you help coordinate a quick reroute?

sam: on it. First step: silence the noisy binding so we stop fanout while we fix tag mapping.

alice: silencing for 30m now. command: `devops-bot silence-pager --service inference-api-prod-alt --duration 30m --by alice` :white_check_mark:

devops-bot: OK — silence applied to service inference-api-prod-alt for 30 minutes (until 03:05Z).

bob: while silenced, we should wire a temp override: route metric alert to ops-day rotation. Quick PD CLI:```pd service update-binding --service inference-api-prod-alt --tag inference-prod-v2 --rotation ops-day```I can run with approval.

carla: I can apply tag rename back in infra, but that will take ~15-20m to propagate. If we use PD CLI override it's faster. I'd prefer minimal infra churn during night.

alice: approved. Bob, go ahead with the PD CLI override and confirm when done. I'll stay on the thread and notify support/customer impact.

bob: running now. `pd service update-binding --service inference-api-prod-alt --tag inference-prod-v2 --rotation ops-day`

bob: done — PD binding updated, test alert fired to verify.

alice: test alert came through to ops-day, confirmed. Removing silence? Keep 15m left on silence; I'll let it expire so we don't re-fanout mid-fix.

sam: meanwhile, can we confirm customer impact? Telemetry shows an uptick in 502/503 from a small subset of edge nodes starting 02:33Z. Total affected requests ~1200 over 5m window, error rate peaked at 14%. Sounds like transient model routing failure; customers will see intermittent failed generations.

alice: noted. Escalating to customer-support for heads-up. @support-team please prepare a proactive note if we see any support tickets.

carla: infra rollback plan: revert PR #987 tags to previous value; apply as infra change but with a staged rollout to avoid ripples. ETA ~25m to full propagation. I'll start the rollback now.

devops-bot: Started rollback job job-20260315-22 on terraform state. Progress logs streaming to /ops/builds/job-20260315-22.log

bob: after PD override + silence, paging stopped to night rotation. Monitoring error rate — it already started drifting down. Keeping watch.

alice: oncall handoff note: I'll stay on until 03:30Z then hand over to @bob for follow-up and postmortem action.

sam: noting next steps: 1) Confirm rollback finished and infra tags restored. 2) Reconcile PD routing rules so tag->rotation mapping uses stable key (avoid tag names that change with deploys). 3) Postmortem and runbook update for tag-change lead to misrouting.

carla: rollback complete — tags restored. Propagation finished at 02:59Z. Verified PD binding now matches infra tag 'inference-prod-v2'.

bob: monitoring shows error rate back to baseline (~0.9%) and no new pages in the last 10m.

alice: handing off to @bob at 03:30Z. I'll add a summary to incidents board and kick off a postmortem. Immediate mitigation steps worked (silence + PD override + rollback).

bob: taking over. I'll draft the incident summary and a follow-up with Infra/Platform to change PD routing to use stable service IDs instead of tags. Also will add a check in merge pipeline to warn when PR changes service tags.

sam: customer impact note: small subset of requests failed for ~25m window; we'll mark as 'minor disruption' and include request counts/regions in postmortem.

alice: thanks everyone. Action items: Carla — add safe-rollback steps in PR template; Bob — PD routing change plan; Sam — customer comms draft; Alice — schedule postmortem meeting.

devops-bot: Incident INC-20260315-01 resolved (monitoring ok). Postmortem ticket created: PMT-20260315-7.

bob: resolving thread. We'll keep postmortem updates in #incidents and attach to the ticket. :white_check_mark:
